# Rounded fixed-step solver: no growing coefficient denominators

Root author addendum to BOUNDED_PROJECTION_ACQUISITION.md, pending independent review.

All means are exact rationals in[-1,1]. At dictionary size m>=1 use B=m, alpha as in the main construction, delta=B²alpha, and Gbar=Ghat+m alpha I. Check Gbar PSD by an exact rational procedure; otherwise latch failure. Its entries have absolute value<=2. The target linear term is Khat*d with ||d||_1<=B, or a prefix cross vector with entry bounds1. Constant target terms do not enter optimization.

Let q(c)=c*Gbar c-2c*k on ||c||_1<=B. Then ||gradient q(c)||_infty<=6B. A safe Frank-Wolfe curvature bound is C=16mB²: along any feasible segment q(c+theta(s-c))<=q(c)-theta gap+(C/2)theta². Set theta=delta/C<1.

Choose a fixed dyadic h=2^-p satisfying

 h<=delta²/(24 C B m).

Start EACH solve at c=0. At each iteration find the exact signed l1-ball vertex s minimizing the empirical gradient. Compute the exact FW gap. If gap<=delta, return c and that certificate. Otherwise compute z=(1-theta)c+theta s, then round EACH coordinate of z toward zero to a multiple of h, giving the next c.

Rounding preserves ||c||_1<=B. It changes l1 distance by at most m h, so it can increase q by at most6Bmh<=delta²/(4C). Before rounding, gap>delta guarantees decrease at least delta²/(2C). Thus a nonterminal rounded step decreases q by at least delta²/(4C).

A safe full-domain objective range is R=8mB². Consequently

 N=1+ceil(4 C R/delta²)

is a deterministic sufficient iteration cap whenever the PSD guard passes, even on a statistical bad event. Exceeding the cap latches failure. No limiting iteration or uncharged exact optimizer is assumed. The same exact FW gap certifies objective suboptimality<=delta by convexity; no rounding allowance needs adding to the final returned objective-gap certificate.

Every retained iterate has coordinates in h*Z and absolute values<=B. Its bit height is therefore O(log B+log(1/h)), NOT linear in N. Each temporary exact update uses only the fixed rational theta and a grid point, and is immediately rounded. Mean denominators, input tolerance bit height, and exact rational gradient arithmetic are all charged; their sizes are polynomial in log m, log(1/lambda), and the encoded confidence/tolerance parameters. ## Finite-bit bound

Choose p as the least nonnegative integer satisfying 2^-p<=delta^2/(24CBm), by exact rational comparisons. Since alpha>=lambda/(3072m^3), the step count is O(m^8lambda^-2), but

    p=O(log(m+1)+log(lambda^-1)+tolerance input bitheight).

Each stored coefficient has O(p+log B) bits, independent of N. Initialize every solve at zero; input d is the seed or a previous grid-valued solve. The intermediate unrounded step combines fixed-grid coefficients with rational theta, then immediately returns to the fixed grid by exact integer quotient toward zero. Computing that intermediate value also has only O(L_*) bits, where L_* is the input/confidence/word-size quantity defined in the preceding receipt. Empirical binary means share the epoch shot-count denominator; repairing the diagonal and adding fixed-grid products preserves polynomial O(L_*) bitheight, including logarithmic summation factors.

With naive schoolbook arithmetic, an exact dense gradient/gap step costs O(m^2L_*^2) bit operations. A solve therefore costs O(m^10lambda^-2L_*^2). At most O(H) solves per rejected/acquiring stage and W+1 stages give W-degree at most 11. Moment acquisition has degree at most 8; exact PSD tests, bilinear corrections and outward roots have smaller degree. For example a safe common DIGITAL envelope is

    C(k+H+1)^2(H+1)^5(W+1)^16(1+lambda^-1)^2 L_*^6.

Thus the previously recommended beta=delta_stat/(W+1)^64 is more than sufficient for polynomial unconditional expected acquisition. No unproved polynomial-QP blackbox, exact line search, or unknown Gram eigenvalue enters this bound. The iteration count and polynomial constants can nevertheless be enormous.

The same proof applies to candidate-prefix distance solves, with their target coefficient mass one and the same conservative delta, C, h and objective-range bounds. All preceding failure-latch, source encoding, actual-adjoint, horizon, and physical-cost qualifications remain in force.
